cells: **SANCTIONED 2026-09-10 under the amended page-overrides-file ruling, shape 1 (file SILENT).** The page grants CC0 and the `.bvh` states nothing, which is an omission rather than a contradiction, so the page governs. The measurement below stands exactly as recorded and is why this is shape 1 rather than shape 3 — it found silence, not a copyleft notice. PREVIOUSLY: REFUSED on the header — page says CC0, FILE SAYS NOTHING.** **MEASURED 2026-08-20 (#497):** all **1016 lines** of `Laying on Back 0001.bvh` grepped for `license|licence|CC0|CC-0|CC BY|AGPL|GPL|author|copyright|public domain|creative commons` — **zero matches.** Bare `HIERARCHY` block, no comment or author stanza, Frames: 1. Per the standing rule that **unspecified is a refusal**, this does not clear on its own header. My earlier row guessed the page-vs-header trap "may not apply the same way" to a `.bvh`; it applies, just as silence rather than contradiction. **Three for three on this site** that the page is not the licence (`mhair02` page-CC0/AGPL3 header, `hair01` page-CC0/MIXED, this page-CC0/silent).

`Laying on Back 0001.bvh` / `0002.bvh`. 001: *"laying on bed with arms to the sides, head & neck tilted up to rest on pillow"*; 002 also raises/spreads the knees. **hm08-native.** **CORRECTED 2026-08-20 by the superagent:** that is true for the LIBRARY rail, NOT automatically for the learner MPFB rig. `retarget-drives-the-library-rig.test.ts` measured the Mixamo target map at **52/52 on hm08 and 0/52 on the MPFB 137-bone rig**. Whether a MakeHuman source map binds on MPFB is **the first measurement**, not an assumption. My original row asserted "no retarget required" and overstated it.

**`reject_measured`.** Target side WORKS — identified as `MPFB2 default_no_toes`, so the committed map binds and the "0/52 on MPFB" figure was the **stock Mixamo** map, not this one. **SOURCE side is the blocker:** `retarget_bvh` auto-identification raises *"Shoulder breast.R has no children"* (`armature.py:215`) on the BVH's `breast.L`/`breast.R` **leaf** joints, so `action=None` and `drivenBoneCount: 0`. Supine today is 17 hand-authored eulers tuned against the 23-bone Anny rig — **`#495`'s ablation proved those eulers ARE the crumple** on the MPFB rail.

**SUPERSEDES the planned hand-authored MPFB euler table.** D1: wire the proven asset, do not hand-author. This is exactly the curious-researcher case — a VERIFIED CC0 asset that replaces planned bespoke work, found before the work started. Consumer already exists: `retarget_bvh` + `motion_bind_stage` (headless), proven once with a CMU walk.
